name: week
title: Warranty desk: this week
subtitle: Open claims, customer contact and returned parts

sections.title: Needs attention
sections.sql: SELECT number,reason,detail,owner FROM v_attention ORDER BY number,reason

sections.title: Claim queue
sections.sql: SELECT number,status,owner,currency,claimed_cents,age_days FROM v_claims ORDER BY age_days DESC

sections.title: Outstanding supplier credits
sections.sql: SELECT name,number,supplier,currency,requested_cents,recovered_cents,outstanding_cents,due_on FROM v_recoveries ORDER BY due_on

sections.title: Failure patterns
sections.sql: SELECT * FROM v_failures ORDER BY currency,claimed_cents DESC

name: compliance
title: Warranty record checks
subtitle: Evidence gaps for operator review, not a legal determination

sections.title: Checks and source references
sections.sql: SELECT number,rule,finding,source FROM v_compliance ORDER BY number,rule

sections.title: Contractual limits
sections.sql: SELECT number,serial,product,contractual_check,currency,claimed_cents FROM v_coverage ORDER BY number,serial
